traits.anchorage_per_stem_kg.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for noble, grand and balsam fir: C_reg 163 N m per kg of green stem, the mean over its four soil groups and three rooting depths and over those species, from tree-pulling tests (Nicoll et al. 2006 and others, listed in the Critical Resistive Moments vignette). A species with its own pulling tests states its own.

traits.crown_drag_at_rest.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for noble, grand and balsam fir: crown drag coefficient on the silhouette Cd = C u^-N with C 3.93, N 0.73, fitted between 10 and 23 m/s (means over those species), after Mayhead's (1973) wind-tunnel drag of whole trees and later studies (Streamlining and Drag vignette).

traits.architectural_model.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 485 names Abies among the trees of Massart's model: an erect monopodial trunk with rhythmic, regular tiers of horizontal branches.

traits.note: Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 65), Abies: leaves kept usually 8 to 10 years; seed cones stand upright on the upper side of the branchlets near the top of the tree and ripen in their first autumn, when their scales fall with the bracts and seeds and leave the bare axis on the branch.
